description: What the MIX-FPGA Windows (x64) DE10-Lite toolchain consists of, who owns each part, and how it is verified. Nothing is packaged or released from this file yet. Runtime location (development): toolchains/experimental, or $MIXFPGA_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT; created by scripts/mixfpga/assemble-windows.mjs.
architecture: x86-64 (PE machine 0x8664) for every owned executable and DLL; Windows system DLLs come from the OS

components.name: GHDL
components.license: GPL-2.0-or-later; runtime DLLs: GCC Runtime Library Exception (libgcc_s_seh-1, libgnat-15), MIT-style (libwinpthread-1), Zlib (zlib1); IEEE library sources carry their own LICENSE
components.provenance: Copied byte-for-byte from the validated NexysVHDL Toolchain 1.0 (win32-x64) into toolchains/experimental/ghdl-6.0.0 by scripts/mixfpga/assemble-windows.mjs; the original is untouched and is never used at run time.

components.name: Yosys
components.role: RTL Schematic (read GHDL netlist, proc, write JSON); no synthesis or place and route
components.license: ISC; DLLs: libstdc++/libgcc (GPL-3.0 with GCC Runtime Library Exception), readline 8 (GPL-3.0), Tcl 8.6 (Tcl/Tk license), libffi (MIT), termcap, libwinpthread (MIT-style), zlib (Zlib)
components.source: https://github.com/YosysHQ/yosys (git 66306a8ca) via YosysHQ OSS CAD Suite windows-x64 as packaged by FPGAwars tools-oss-cad-suite 2026-09-15
components.provenance: yosys.exe, the DLLs its PE import table needs (resolved recursively) and share/yosys copied byte-for-byte from NexysVHDL Toolchain 1.0 apio/packages/oss-cad-suite into toolchains/experimental/yosys-0.63. The original is untouched and never used at run time.

components.name: MIX-FPGA adapters and scripts
components.role: Board profiles, providers, Windows Quartus executor (platform/windows/de10)

components.name: Quartus Prime Lite Edition
components.role: FPGA implementation for the DE10-Lite (MAX 10); native Windows command-line tools
components.install: Supplied by the student from Altera's official download page after accepting the Altera license. Not redistributed by MIX-FPGA.

components.name: Quartus Programmer (quartus_pgm, jtagconfig)
components.role: Windows DE10-Lite programming: .sof into SRAM over JTAG through the standard Altera USB-Blaster driver. openFPGALoader cannot open that driver, and MIX-FPGA never replaces drivers.
components.install: Installed with Quartus Prime Lite. Not redistributed by MIX-FPGA.

components.name: MAX 10 device support
components.install: Supplied by the student (max10-25.1std.0.1129.qdz) together with Quartus. Not redistributed by MIX-FPGA.
